서울대학교 경영대학 학부 및 대학원(석사·박사)을 졸업한 자는 정회원이: Graduates of SNU Business School's undergraduate and graduate (master's and doctoral) programs are regular members.
경영대학이 운영하는 MBA, EMBA, 최고경영자과정 등 전문·특별 과정: Completers of professional and special programs run by the school, such as the MBA, EMBA and executive programs, may become members as determined by the founding assembly or the Board.
Current and former faculty of SNU Business School are honorary members.
확인된 중퇴자는 기별 동문회장의 추천을 받아 이사회 의결로 회원이 될 수: Verified former students who did not graduate may become members by Board resolution on the recommendation of their class chapter president.
Regular members may vote at the General Assembly and elect and be elected as officers.
회원은 회비를 납부하고 본 회칙과 총회·이사회의 결의를 준수할 의무를 진: Members shall pay dues and abide by these bylaws and the resolutions of the General Assembly and the Board.
Honorary members may attend and speak at the General Assembly but do not vote.
본회는 회원의 개인정보를 개인정보보호법 등 관계 법령에 따라 보호하며,: The association protects members' personal data under the Personal Information Protection Act and related laws, and uses it in the register and online services only within the visibility each member sets.
The association has the following officers:
부회장 30인 내외 (기별 동문회장은 당연직 부회장이 된다): About 30 Vice Presidents (class chapter presidents are ex officio Vice Presidents)
The President is elected by the General Assembly on the recommendation of the Nominating Committee.
수석부회장과 부회장은 회장이 이사회의 동의를 얻어 위촉하며, 감사는 총회: Senior Vice Presidents and Vice Presidents are appointed by the President with the consent of the Board; Auditors are elected by the General Assembly.
이사는 기별·과정별 동문회의 추천을 받은 회원 중에서 기수를 안배하여 회: Directors are appointed by the President from members recommended by class and program chapters, with balance across class years.
The Secretary-General is appointed by the President.
본회는 전임 회장을 명예회장으로, 전임 부회장을 명예부회장으로 추대할 수: Former Presidents may be named Honorary Presidents and former Vice Presidents Honorary Vice Presidents; several Advisors may be appointed.
Officers serve two-year terms; the President may serve one consecutive additional term.
An officer filling a vacancy serves the remainder of the predecessor's term.
Officers whose terms have expired continue to serve until successors are appointed.
The President represents the association and oversees its affairs.
수석부회장은 회장을 보좌하며 회장 유고 시 회장이 지명한 순서에 따라 그: Senior Vice Presidents assist the President and act in the President's absence in the order designated by the President.
Vice Presidents assist the President and manage delegated affairs.
감사는 본회의 회계와 업무를 감사하여 총회에 보고하며, 이사회에 출석하여: Auditors audit the accounts and affairs, report to the General Assembly and may attend and speak at the Board.
The Secretary-General runs the secretariat under the President's direction.
The General Assembly consists of regular members and meets in regular and extraordinary sessions.
정기총회는 매년 1회 회장이 소집하고, 임시총회는 회장이 필요하다고 인정: The regular General Assembly is convened once a year by the President; an extraordinary session is convened when the President deems it necessary or at the request of one third of the Directors or 100 or more regular members.
총회는 다음 사항을 의결한다. ① 회칙의 제정과 개정 ② 회장과 감사의: The General Assembly resolves: ① enactment and amendment of the bylaws ② election of the President and Auditors ③ approval of plans, budgets and accounts ④ other matters referred by the Board.
총회는 출석 회원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결하되, 회칙 개정은 출석 회원 3: Resolutions require a majority of members present; amendments to the bylaws require two thirds.
By Board resolution, the General Assembly may also vote online or in writing.
이사회는 회장, 수석부회장, 부회장, 이사로 구성하며 회장이 의장이 된다: The Board consists of the President, Senior Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents and Directors, chaired by the President.
이사회는 다음 사항을 의결한다. ① 총회에 부의할 안건 ② 회비와 입회비: The Board resolves: ① matters to refer to the General Assembly ② dues and admission fees ③ execution of activities and use of the budget ④ establishment and operation of committees ⑤ membership matters ⑥ other matters referred by the President.
이사회는 재적 이사 과반수의 출석과 출석 이사 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다: A quorum is a majority of Directors; resolutions require a majority of those present.
회장단 회의는 회장, 명예회장, 수석부회장, 부회장, 감사, 사무총장으로: The Presidents' Council consists of the President, Honorary Presidents, Senior Vice Presidents, Vice Presidents, Auditors and the Secretary-General, and deliberates matters for the Board and urgent affairs.
본회는 사업의 효율적 추진을 위하여 장학위원회, 행사위원회, 홍보·출판위: The association maintains Scholarship, Events, Communications, Membership and Finance Committees; the Board may create or dissolve committees. Chairs are appointed by the President from among Vice Presidents and Directors.
본회의 재원은 입회비, 연회비, 평생회비, 분담금, 찬조금, 기부금 및: Funded by admission fees, annual dues, lifetime dues, contributions, sponsorships, donations and other income.
The types and amounts of dues are set by the Board and reported to the General Assembly.
Members who have paid lifetime dues are exempt from annual dues.
회비는 계좌 이체 또는 본회가 정하는 온라인 결제 수단으로 납부할 수 있: Dues may be paid by bank transfer or online payment methods designated by the association.
본회는 장학사업을 위하여 장학기금을 별도로 관리하며, 기금의 운용과 장학: A separate Scholarship Fund is maintained; its management and scholar selection are handled by the Scholarship Committee and reported to the General Assembly. A scholarship foundation may be established by Board resolution.
The fiscal year runs from January 1 to December 31.
회장은 회계연도 종료 후 결산서를 작성하여 감사의 감사를 거쳐 정기총회에: After each fiscal year the President prepares accounts, which are audited, reported to the regular General Assembly and summarized on the website.
본 회칙은 이사회의 발의 또는 정회원 50인 이상의 발의로 총회에서 개정: These bylaws are amended by the General Assembly on a proposal of the Board or of 50 or more regular members.
본회가 해산할 때에는 총회의 의결을 거쳐 잔여 재산을 모교 서울대학교 경: Upon dissolution by resolution of the General Assembly, remaining assets are donated to SNU Business School for scholarship purposes.
Detailed rules for implementing these bylaws are set by the Board.
These bylaws take effect on the date adopted by the founding assembly.
Acts of the Preparatory Committee before establishment are succeeded by the association.
The first officers serve from the founding assembly until the regular General Assembly of 2029.
